tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and editor background. iTerm2 source: Background Color. Also the ink on filled glyphs (a done checkbox's tick).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar, title bars, panel headers. Background, darker.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Selected rows (every picked row in a multi-selection), active sidebar item, pressed chips, highlighted menu items, search field, scrollbar thumb. iTerm2 source: Selection Color, else Background + 16% Foreground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes and group headers; 1px only. Background + 10% Foreground.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Raw-markdown lines (the cursor line), inline code bubbles, code blocks, table header rows, rows waiting in Logbook, input fields. Background + 5% Foreground.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text, task titles, property values on bg. iTerm2 source: Foreground Color, lifted to 5.5:1 on bg where needed.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Headings, selected-row titles, active navigation. Foreground moved 45% toward black (light schemes) or white (dark schemes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, YAML keys, counts, done and cancelled titles, empty checkboxes. Ansi 8, lifted until it reaches 4.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, project progress pies, the text caret, YAML keys in source mode, the Loose tasks icon, the 2px ring on a right-clicked row, a highlighted menu item's icon, tag glyphs and tag chips (fill 10%, 14% on dark schemes; ring 28%, 32%), the Vault settings icon. iTerm2 source: Ansi 4 Blue.

tokens.name: due
tokens.usage: dueDate: the calendar glyph, the Today star, date values in source; ==highlights== at 30% (26% on dark schemes), question callouts, the Hotkeys settings icon. Icons, dots and fills only, never text on light themes. iTerm2 source: Ansi 3 Yellow.

tokens.name: deadline
tokens.usage: deadline: the flag glyph, the Upcoming icon, destructive confirmation, the Delete Forever menu item (its highlight is a 14% tint, 22% on dark schemes), the Integrations settings icon. Icons and fills only. iTerm2 source: Ansi 1 Red.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status Done: the filled checkbox, the Logbook icon, the folder line's icon while the folder is watched, iCloud Drive's dot in Settings. iTerm2 source: Ansi 2 Green.

tokens.name: doing
tokens.usage: Status Doing ([/]) and a project's Ongoing ([>]): checkbox border and glyph, status dot; the area cube, the Editor settings icon. iTerm2 source: Ansi 6 Cyan.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Status Blocked ([B]): checkbox border and bar, status dot; a local folder's dot in Settings, warning triangles, the Notifications settings icon. Red mixed halfway to Yellow.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: [[wikilinks]] and backlinks, the parent property chip, notes folders and the Notes switch icon, the Themes settings icon. iTerm2 source: Ansi 5 Magenta.

styles.name: title-view
styles.usage: The domain title at the top of a browser pane: Today, Upcoming, Logbook, Trash.

styles.name: title-file
styles.usage: A file's title at the top of the editor.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: ### headings in the editor (H3), and section headings such as Subtasks.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: #### headings in the editor, in strong.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: ##### headings in the editor, in fg.

styles.name: heading-6
styles.usage: ###### headings in the editor, in muted.

styles.name: group
styles.usage: Group headers in lists: dates, projects.

styles.name: body-editor
styles.sample: Bring the project instruction files in line with how I work now.

styles.name: task
styles.usage: Task titles in browser rows; slash and checkbox menu items.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: UI text: navigation, buttons, settings, file menu items.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Ta Da MVP · Deadline Tue 6 Oct
styles.usage: The meta line under a note row's title, footers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the sidebar and dialogs.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: YAML property keys, file paths in breadcrumbs, table column heads.

styles.name: syntax
styles.usage: Checkbox syntax and folder names in settings.

styles.name: code-text
styles.usage: Inline code bubbles and code blocks in the Live editor.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-count gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between filter chips; small icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in toolbars and breadcrumbs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row inner padding, icon-to-label gap, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between meta chips; card gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: List padding; panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Toolbar side padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Browser pane side padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Editor side padding; space above a view title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Single-pane content padding (Logbook, Trash).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes (16px box).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code and highlight bubbles, the caret's raw line, source lines, inner segmented options, file menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, sidebar items, buttons, inputs, slash and checkbox menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, grouped settings and menus; callouts, code blocks, tables and images in the editor.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: property, tag, filter and Group chips, count badges.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width; 200px in Settings.

tokens.name: size-browser
tokens.usage: Browser pane width in two-pane views (320–460px until its rule is dragged, then at least 260px); the editor fills the rest.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Sidebar items and single-line controls.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Property, tag, filter and Group chips; the sidebar switch's segments.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Editor toolbar and dialog title bar height.

tokens.name: size-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox and icon size in rows.

tokens.name: size-menu
tokens.usage: Full menu width: slash, link, checkbox, callout and property menus.

tokens.name: size-menu-item
tokens.usage: Full menu item height.

tokens.name: size-menu-compact
tokens.usage: Compact menu width: the file menu and rightClickMenu.

tokens.name: size-menu-item-compact
tokens.usage: Compact menu item height.
